title: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
description: PPG-Bench standardizes evaluation of five PPG foundation models across diverse datasets and adaptation regimes, finding that their released representations often fail to beat simple physiological features or a generic time-series model. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Arvasu Kulkarni et al., arXiv:2610.13435v1 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13435v1
